documents.lyricsOriginal:
[Verse 1]
Four in the morning
And I'm still wide awake
Counting the cracks in the ceiling
Like they're my last mistake

I traced your name on the window
But the fog had faded away
Guess I'm holding on to nothing
The way I always do

[Pre-Chorus]
And I don't know why I keep calling
When the line's already dead

[Chorus]
You took the light with you when you left
Left me here in the quiet
Heavy heart and hollow chest
And I'm still trying to deny it
You took the light with you when you left

[Post-Chorus]
When you left
When you left

[Verse 2]
Your sweater still in the closet
Smells like you on rainy days
I wear it when I get lonely
Like a ghost I can't erase

I scroll through all of our pictures
Til my thumb starts to ache
Every smile feels like a stranger
From a life I couldn't save

[Pre-Chorus]
And I don't know why I keep hoping
When there's nothing left to say

[Chorus]
You took the light with you when you left
Left me here in the quiet
Heavy heart and hollow chest
And I'm still trying to deny it
You took the light with you when you left

[Post-Chorus]
When you left
When you left

[Bridge]
Maybe someday I'll stop counting
Maybe someday I'll forget
But tonight I'm just a shadow
Of a person I regret

[Chorus]
You took the light with you when you left
Left me here in the quiet
Heavy heart and hollow chest
And I'm still trying to deny it
You took the light with you when you left
